Container.Name: RabbitHole-Fork
Container.Overview: A fork of The Rabbit Hole by darthspaders (github.com/darthspaders/RoonAI): music discovery and playback for Roon and Lyrion Music Server, with Lyrion, HQPlayer and interface additions. Host networking lets Roon find the extension; a br0 custom network with its own IP on the Roon Core's network also works. After starting, enable The Rabbit Hole in Roon under Settings, Extensions. The web UI and API have no login: keep it on a trusted LAN and never forward port 3777.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Roon pairing, ratings, history, saved candidates and provider tokens.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web UI and API. With host networking this is the port on the Unraid server.

Config.Name: Lyrion server URL
Config.Description: LMS web address, for example http://192.168.1.10:9000. Leave empty if you only use Roon.

Config.Name: LLM provider
Config.Description: ollama, openai-compatible (LM Studio, llama.cpp) or openrouter. Their URL, model and key fields are under Show more settings.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Ollama address, for example http://192.168.1.10:11434.

Config.Name: Ollama model
Config.Description: Model name exactly as ollama list shows it, for example qwen2.5:14b.

Config.Name: LLM URL
Config.Description: For openai-compatible: the server's /v1 address, for example http://192.168.1.10:1234/v1.

Config.Name: LLM model
Config.Description: For openai-compatible: the model name the server reports.

Config.Name: LLM API key
Config.Description: For an openai-compatible server that needs a key.

Config.Name: OpenRouter API key
Config.Description: For openrouter.

Config.Name: OpenRouter model
Config.Description: For openrouter, for example openai/gpt-4o-mini.

Config.Name: TIDAL client ID
Config.Description: From developer.tidal.com. Discovery searches the TIDAL catalogue.

Config.Name: TIDAL client secret
Config.Description: From developer.tidal.com.

Config.Name: Default theme
Config.Description: original, copper, roon, roon-light, dark-orange or graphite-brass. Each browser can pick its own in Settings.

Config.Name: Roon HQPlayer zones
Config.Description: Shows HQPlayer's output under the art for Roon zones that play through HQPlayer: zone=host pairs, comma separated, for example HQPd=192.168.1.30.

Config.Name: HQPlayer web URL
Config.Description: Overrides the HQPlayer web interface link found from the HQPlayer Bridge plugin.

Config.Name: HQPTuner URL
Config.Description: Adds an HQPTuner link under Playback System, for example http://192.168.1.20:8090.

Config.Name: Rouen URL
Config.Description: Adds a Rouen link next to Roon and Lyrion, for example http://192.168.1.21:3399.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the data folder. 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the data folder. 100 is Unraid's users.
